notes: The root is Jin’s Sima Yi, anchored by the existing 司馬宣王/Meng Da members and Jin ancestral context.

jiutangshu:029:s0145,s0159–s0167 discusses the Tang ancestral temple’s seven generations and removal of 宣皇帝’s tablet. This is the Tang ancestor conventionally named Li Xi, not the Wei general posthumously honored by Jin. The reused title does not establish identity.
